org_positions.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
org_positions.main_objective: Provide strategic leadership, institutional governance, and executive alignment across all Smart Masar departments and impact programs.
org_positions.main_objective_ar: توجيه الرؤية الاستراتيجية والحوكمة المؤسسية وضمان التكامل بين جميع إدارات وبرامج مسار الذكي.
org_positions.key_tasks_json: ["Approve annual strategic plans, organizational budgets, and key executive policies.","Chair executive governance committees and oversee institutional performance targets.","Represent Smart Masar in high-level donor, partner, and board engagements."]
org_positions.responsibilities_json: ["Accountable for organizational sustainability, governance compliance, and strategic outcomes.","Final executive sign-off on approved structural expansions and executive appointments."]
org_positions.scope_of_authority: Organization-wide strategic, financial, and structural approval authority.
org_positions.functional_permissions_json: ["Approve budgets & org structure","Authorize strategic partnerships","Chair executive reviews"]
org_positions.decision_boundaries: Board-mandated governance limits; operational decisions delegated to department directors.
org_positions.required_reports_json: ["Quarterly Institutional Performance Scorecard","Annual Impact & Financial Audit Brief"]
org_positions.kpis_json: ["Strategic plan milestone attainment >= 90%","Organizational compliance audit score >= 95%"]

org_positions.title: Digital Transformation & AI Advisory Lead
org_positions.main_objective: Advise executive leadership and operational departments on digital roadmap execution, assessment automation, and responsible AI adoption.
org_positions.main_objective_ar: تقديم الاستشارات للقيادة التنفيذية والإدارات حول خارطة طريق التحول الرقمي وأتمتة التقييم وتبني الذكاء الاصطناعي المسؤول.
org_positions.key_tasks_json: ["Evaluate digital maturity across HR, MEAL, and Operations workflows.","Provide non-binding technical & governance recommendations to Executive Management."]
org_positions.responsibilities_json: ["Design enterprise digital transformation blueprints and AI ethics guardrails.","Review system interoperability standards across internal databases and portals."]
org_positions.scope_of_authority: Advisory authority across departments; no direct line-management authority over operational staff.
org_positions.functional_permissions_json: ["Review architecture blueprints","Propose digital policies","Audit AI workflow fairness"]
org_positions.decision_boundaries: Advisory sign-off only; budget and staffing approvals remain with CEO and Department Directors.
org_positions.required_reports_json: ["Bi-annual Digital Maturity Assessment","AI Ethics & Readiness Advisory Memo"]
org_positions.kpis_json: ["Digital workflow adoption rate >= 85%","Zero unmitigated AI governance findings"]

org_positions.title: Director of Human Resources & Talent Operations
org_positions.main_objective: Lead talent acquisition, competency frameworks, workforce planning, and HR governance across Smart Masar.
org_positions.main_objective_ar: قيادة استقطاب المواهب وأطر الكفاءات وتخطيط القوى العاملة وحوكمة الموارد البشرية.
org_positions.key_tasks_json: ["Oversee competency-based recruitment campaigns and final hiring committees.","Maintain approved headcount plans, job profiles, and organizational role clarity."]
org_positions.responsibilities_json: ["Ensure fair, transparent, and standardized competency assessment across all hiring.","Coordinate workforce capacity planning with Department Heads."]
org_positions.scope_of_authority: Departmental leadership over HR workflows, hiring governance, and competency standards.
org_positions.functional_permissions_json: ["Approve hiring campaigns","Review HR policies","Manage competency standards"]
org_positions.decision_boundaries: Headcount additions require Finance budget clearance and Executive approval.
org_positions.required_reports_json: ["Monthly Recruitment Funnel & Time-to-Hire Report","Quarterly Workforce Readiness Report"]
org_positions.kpis_json: ["Time-to-fill approved vacancies <= 35 days","100% of hires assessed via structured competency matrix"]

org_positions.title: Head of Program Quality & Impact (MEAL)
org_positions.main_objective: Direct institutional Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning standards across all active programs.
org_positions.main_objective_ar: قيادة معايير المتابعة والتقييم والمساءلة والتعلم عبر جميع البرامج والمشاريع.
org_positions.key_tasks_json: ["Supervise MEAL officers and validate program LogFrames and IPTT data integrity.","Ensure beneficiary accountability mechanisms (CRM/CFRM) operate to donor compliance standards."]
org_positions.responsibilities_json: ["Sign off on quarterly and annual donor impact reports.","Lead after-action learning reviews and methodological audits."]
org_positions.scope_of_authority: Technical and supervisory authority over Program Quality & MEAL unit.
org_positions.functional_permissions_json: ["Approve MEAL frameworks","Audit survey datasets","Supervise MEAL team"]
org_positions.decision_boundaries: Program budget reallocations require Operations and Finance concurrence.
org_positions.required_reports_json: ["Quarterly Program Impact Digest","CRM Accountability Closure Summary"]
org_positions.kpis_json: ["100% donor MEAL compliance rate","95% CRM closure within SLA"]

org_positions.key_tasks_json: ["Lead monthly financial closes, donor financial reporting, and variance analysis.","Verify budget availability prior to opening new approved positions or vendor contracts."]

org_positions.title: Technology & AI Engineering Director
org_positions.main_objective: Architect, secure, and scale Smart Masar software platforms, databases, and AI-enabled evaluation workflows.

org_positions.key_tasks_json: ["Manage software engineering, database reliability, RBAC security, and API integrations.","Partner with Operations and HR on platform automation and analytics dashboards."]
org_positions.responsibilities_json: ["Ensure 99.9% platform uptime, strict role-based security, and zero PII leakage."]
org_positions.scope_of_authority: Technical architecture, deployment, and production security governance.
org_positions.functional_permissions_json: ["Approve production releases","Enforce security standards","Manage API integrations"]
org_positions.decision_boundaries: Data retention and privacy policies co-approved with Governance & Compliance.
org_positions.required_reports_json: ["Monthly System Uptime & Security Report","Quarterly Engineering Velocity Brief"]

org_positions.title: Governance, Risk & Compliance Officer
org_positions.main_objective: Enforce institutional policies, RBAC segregation of duties, audit readiness, and personal data protection.
org_positions.main_objective_ar: إنفاذ السياسات المؤسسية وفصل الصلاحيات والجاهزية للتدقيق وحماية البيانات الشخصية.
org_positions.key_tasks_json: ["Conduct periodic RBAC access audits and review structural approval trails.","Maintain enterprise risk register and compliance checklists."]
org_positions.responsibilities_json: ["Verify privacy compliance across candidate and organizational modules."]
org_positions.scope_of_authority: Independent compliance inspection and audit escalation authority.
org_positions.functional_permissions_json: ["Inspect audit logs","Flag policy non-compliance","Review RBAC permissions"]
org_positions.decision_boundaries: Advisory and compliance veto on non-compliant releases; operational fixes executed by owners.
org_positions.required_reports_json: ["Quarterly Governance & RBAC Audit Report","Data Protection Compliance Review"]
org_positions.kpis_json: ["100% audit log coverage on structural changes","Zero unresolved high-risk privacy gaps"]

org_positions.key_tasks_json: ["Manage operational timelines across recruitment waves and client assessment projects.","Resolve cross-team resource bottlenecks with HR, Tech, and Finance."]
org_positions.responsibilities_json: ["Deliver projects on schedule, within budget, and aligned with SLA quality commitments."]
org_positions.scope_of_authority: Operational scheduling and team-level workflow coordination.
org_positions.decision_boundaries: Contractual scope changes escalate to Department Director / Executive.
org_positions.required_reports_json: ["Weekly Operations Delivery Tracker","Project Closure & Risk Log"]

org_positions.title: MEAL Officer – Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning Officer
org_positions.title_ar: مسؤول المتابعة والتقييم والمساءلة والتعلم (MEAL Officer)
org_positions.main_objective: Lead evidence-based Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning systems to ensure program quality, data integrity, beneficiary accountability, and donor compliance.
org_positions.main_objective_ar: قيادة أنظمة المتابعة والتقييم والمساءلة والتعلم المبنية على الأدلة لضمان جودة البرامج وسلامة البيانات ومساءلة المستفيدين والامتثال لمعايير المانحين.
org_positions.key_tasks_json: ["Design and maintain project Logical Frameworks (LogFrames), Theory of Change, and Indicator Performance Tracking Tables (IPTT).","Build, validate, and deploy digital data collection forms in KoboToolbox / ODK with strict skip logic and data quality checks.","Clean, analyze, and visualize household and beneficiary survey datasets using Excel (Power Query/Pivot) and Power BI.","Operate and monitor Community Feedback and Complaints Response Mechanisms (CRM/CFRM) ensuring confidential, timely closure.","Draft quarterly and annual donor MEAL reports, learning briefs, and after-action review documentation."]
org_positions.responsibilities_json: ["Own field data validation, anomaly quarantining, and unbiased analytical reporting.","Uphold strict beneficiary data protection and anonymized CRM case handling."]
org_positions.scope_of_authority: Technical authority to quarantine unverified survey records and validate IPTT figures prior to reporting.
org_positions.functional_permissions_json: ["Manage KoboToolbox / ODK forms","Verify IPTT metrics","Escalate sensitive CRM cases"]
org_positions.decision_boundaries: Cannot alter project targets or suppress negative findings without Head of Program Quality & Impact review.
org_positions.required_reports_json: ["Monthly IPTT Update","Post-Distribution Monitoring (PDM) Brief","Quarterly Donor MEAL Report"]
org_positions.kpis_json: ["100% on-time submission of verified IPTT and donor MEAL reports","< 2% survey error/duplicate rate across KoboToolbox submissions","95% of CRM beneficiary feedback resolved within SLA window"]
org_positions.expected_deliverables_json: ["Verified IPTT Workbook","Power BI Program Impact Dashboard","After-Action Learning Briefs"]
